title: Security Brake and Emergency Brake Release
summary: The master handle EB detent and separate Security Brake button activate emergency braking. The emergency brake release control clears the modeled emergency state after release conditions are met.
purpose: Demonstrate emergency activation and the distinct emergency-brake release action at standstill with the master handle at N.
observations: Selecting EB on the master handle activates the emergency brake indication.
Train speed should decrease over time; an emergency command does not instantly stop a moving train.
Traction may be inhibited while the emergency state remains active.
interactions: Select EB on the master handle or press the Security Brake control to request emergency braking.
Observe the emergency indication and deceleration until standstill.
Return the master handle to N and request emergency brake release; the simulator completes release after three seconds.
safetyNotes: Emergency braking is not used as a substitute for routine service braking.
Emergency release at standstill and N is a TRAINEX teaching procedure, not a universal railway procedure.
